description: This Java source file defines a logger class Slf4JLogger that integrates Liquibase logging with SLF4J framework. It maps java.util.logging.Level to corresponding SLF4J log levels and routes log messages accordingly.

classes.name: Slf4JLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class extending AbstractLogger to route Liquibase logs through SLF4J, mapping Java util logging levels to SLF4J levels.
